technical_overview: Offered at $18.0 for 1.5g, this KoColor EYESHADOW is expertly formulated with Mica, Titanium Dioxide, Manganese Violet, Tin Oxide. Delivering a high-fidelity Lavender Haze color profile (`#967BB6`), it leverages advanced engineering via high-purity pigments and volatile carriers. For optimal chromatic impact, apply directly to a clean, prepped surface.
